description: WebStorm JavaScript & TypeScript IDE engineering: deep semantic refactoring, Node.js and Jest/Vitest test runners, ESLint and Prettier automatic synchronization, and npm package dependency management.
instructionsMarkdown:
# WebStorm Modern JavaScript & TypeScript Architecture

Harness WebStorm's semantic AST engine for refactoring, test execution, and code style standardization.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Configure ESLint and Prettier to automatically execute on save across all supported file types.
- Synchronize WebStorm's TypeScript compiler options with the project `tsconfig.json`.
- Commit shared run/debug configurations (`.idea/runConfigurations`) for test suites.
- Enforce explicit, deterministic import path styles (relative vs alias).
